findings.evidence: Bruhat.lean:611 uses RelSeries on W; Mathlib/Order/RelSeries.lean defines singleton with no relation hypothesis. Parabolic.lean:235 defines minimality by length comparison, which fails for simple i when multiplying by itself gives 1.
findings.fix: Use the subtype of minimal coset representatives as the vertex type, or require minimality of every vertex; update bondGcd_singleton in ChainBond.lean:107 to require a valid vertex.
findings.issue: MinimalCosetRepChain constrains vertices only through edges: singleton chains admit every w : W. For J = Set.univ in a nontrivial Coxeter group, singleton (cs.simple i) is admitted although that vertex is not minimal; even the singleton quotient therefore has multiple distinct empty chains.

summary: The chain type admits nonminimal vertices in length-zero chains, so it does not faithfully model chains on minimal coset representatives.
